metadata.name: the_pit
metadata.description: PIT — Private Instant Trading: competitive trading arenas on MagicBlock

instructions.name: bind_series
docs: BASE. Bind an open arena to a series. Permissionless: binding moves no funds and
both accounts already record their creator, so the only rule is that they match.
The round number follows the series calendar.

instructions.name: close_permission
docs: ER. Close the permission and return its rent to the arena PDA.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: ER. Close the open position and realise the PnL, capped at the bankroll.

instructions.name: commit_round
docs: ER. Commit the final arena state and hand ownership back to the base layer.

instructions.name: create_arena
docs: Create an arena on the base layer. The escrow vault is a system-owned PDA
seeded by the arena key, funded here so it stays rent exempt.

instructions.name: create_series
docs: BASE. Open a series: rounds that keep a cumulative score on-chain.

instructions.name: delegate_arena
docs: BASE LAYER. Delegate the arena to the ER so it can be traded on.

instructions.name: end_round
docs: ER. Freeze the round and rank the seats by equity at the final price.

instructions.name: init_permission
docs: ER. Create the ephemeral permission for the arena. Paid by the arena PDA itself
(it signs with its own seeds), idempotent, and starts public — privacy is opt-in
through `set_privacy`.

instructions.name: join_arena
docs: Take a seat. The entry fee goes to the vault on the base layer.

instructions.name: lock_arena
docs: Close registration and start the clock. Still on the base layer: this must
happen *before* the arena is delegated.

instructions.name: open_position
docs: ER. Open a long (side = 1) or short (side = -1) position priced by the oracle.

instructions.name: record_round
docs: BASE. Fold a closed arena into its series standings. Permissionless and idempotent:
the arena remembers it was counted, so a replay cannot inflate the table.
Points: podium 10/6/3 + 1 per bite survived while holding + 2 for the last one standing.

instructions.name: request_shock
docs: ER. Ask the oracle to bite. Permissionless crank: anyone can call it, but the
program enforces the cooldown, so nobody can spam the pit.

accounts.name: oracle_queue
docs: and it has to be writable: the CPI appends the request to it.

instructions.name: set_privacy
docs: ER. Flip the arena between sealed and public. The member list is rebuilt from
scratch on every call — an update replaces it, it does not merge.
Sealed = creator + every seated player can read the rollup state with their own
token; everybody else is rejected at the TEE ingress. Public = no members.

instructions.name: settle
docs: BASE LAYER. Pay the podium out of the escrow vault. Permissionless and
idempotent: the first call flips the arena to `Closed`.
The podium accounts must be passed as `remaining_accounts`, in podium order,
because the vault signs a CPI system transfer to each one and a CPI can only
touch accounts present in its account list.

instructions.name: settle_solo
docs: BASE LAYER. Pay a solo run: the house PDA is the counterparty.
The vault always holds the player's entry. The multiplier decides how
much of it comes back and how much the house adds (or keeps):
`payout = entry * bps / 10_000`, capped at 3× by `solo_multiplier_bps`.
Permissionless and idempotent.

instructions.name: shock_callback
docs: ER. Oracle callback: force-close ONE random seat that is holding risk.
Only seats with an open position are eligible, so being flat is a real defence.
`epoch` must match the arena's shock counter; a replayed or out-of-order callback
returns without touching state, so nobody gets bitten twice for the same request.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

errors.name: NotASeat
errors.msg: Signer is not a seat in this arena

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the arena creator

errors.name: ShockAlreadyApplied
errors.msg: A shock was already applied to this arena

errors.name: ShockCooldown
errors.msg: The pit needs to breathe: shock cooldown not elapsed

errors.name: NoOpenPositions
errors.msg: Nobody is holding risk: no open positions to bite

errors.name: PitAsleep
errors.msg: The pit sleeps before the bell: no bite fits before the round ends

errors.name: SeriesComplete
errors.msg: This series already played all its rounds

errors.name: RoundAlreadyRecorded
errors.msg: This round was already recorded in the series

errors.name: SoloNeedsSettleSolo
errors.msg: A solo run is settled with settle_solo, not settle

errors.name: NotSoloArena
errors.msg: This instruction only applies to a solo arena

errors.name: HouseUnderfunded
errors.msg: The house PDA does not hold enough SOL for this payout

fields.name: nonce
docs: Raw bytes of the PDA nonce, plus its length. Stored so any client can rebuild the
arena seeds without keeping an off-chain registry. Zero-padded.

fields.name: is_private
docs: True while the ephemeral permission seals this arena. Mirrors the permission
account so clients can read the policy without the (devnet-404) status endpoint.

fields.name: shock_seat
docs: Last seat the pit bit, or `NO_SHOCK`.

fields.name: shock_count
docs: How many shocks have landed this round. Also the epoch used to reject stale callbacks.

fields.name: last_shock_ts
docs: Unix ts of the last shock, for the cooldown.

fields.name: series
docs: Serie a la que pertenece la ronda, o `Pubkey::default()` si es partida suelta.

fields.name: round_no
docs: Número de ronda dentro de la serie (1..3).

fields.name: lst_winner
docs: Quien se quedó como única posición abierta al campanazo.

fields.name: lst_bonus
docs: Bono pagado por eso, en lamports. Se calcula en `settle`.

fields.name: series_recorded
docs: Evita que una ronda se cuente dos veces en la serie.

fields.name: wanted
docs: Lo que pidió el agente.

fields.name: executed
docs: Lo que ejecutó el pozo.

types.name: PitResult
docs: Snapshot of a podium place, written on the ER and read after undelegation.

types.name: Seat
docs: One seat in the arena. `bankroll` and `realized` are fixed-point (1e9 == 1.0).

fields.name: side
docs: 0 = flat, 1 = long, -1 = short

fields.name: bites
docs: Cuántas veces el pozo te sacó de una posición.

fields.name: streak
docs: Mordidas seguidas que sobreviviste estando dentro del mercado.

fields.name: pressure
docs: Presión acumulada (0..=100). Al llenarse, el asiento entra en fiebre.

fields.name: mad_until
docs: Unix ts hasta el que el asiento está en fiebre. 0 = cuerdo.

types.name: Series
docs: Tres rondas encadenadas. Los puntos viven on-chain, no en el cliente.

fields.name: count
docs: Shock number for this round, so clients can order the kill feed.

types.name: Standing
docs: Una fila de la tabla de una serie.
